policies.policy_title: Fiscal Responsibility Rule
policies.stated: Manage public finances responsibly to get national debt falling as a share of the economy and ensure day-to-day spending does not exceed taxes, while making necessary investments.

source.quote: Fostering stability, certainty and confidence by managing the public finances responsibly to get the national debt falling as a share of the economy and ensure that day-to-day spending does not exceed the amount raised in taxes, while making the investments our country needs.

policies.policy_title: Increase HMRC Resources to Tackle Tax Avoidance and Evasion
policies.stated: Provide HMRC with the necessary resources to effectively tackle tax avoidance and evasion, aiming to end Conservative waste and ensure value for money for taxpayers.

source.quote: Put an end to Conservative waste and give taxpayers real value for money, giving HMRC the resources it needs to properly tackle tax avoidance and evasion.

policies.policy_title: Reverse Conservative Bank Tax Cuts and Impose Windfall Tax on Energy Companies
policies.stated: Reverse Conservative tax cuts for big banks by restoring Bank Surcharge and Bank Levy revenues to 2016 levels in real terms, and introduce a proper, one-off windfall tax on the super-profits of oil and gas producers and traders.

source.quote: Implement a tax policy that recognises how high the Conservatives have raised personal taxes, making the cost-of-living crisis worse, by instead focusing tax changes on reversing the Conservatives’ tax cuts for big banks and imposing a proper, one-off windfall tax on the super-profits of oil and gas producers and traders.

policies.policy_title: Universal Gigabit Broadband Rollout
policies.stated: Ensure gigabit broadband is available to every home and business across the UK, including in rural and remote communities, with support for local bespoke solutions to ensure no property is left out.

source.quote: Ensuring that gigabit broadband is available to every home and business, including in rural and remote communities, as set out in chapter 15.

policies.policy_title: Raise Income Tax Personal Allowance
policies.stated: Prioritise cutting income tax by raising the tax-free personal allowance when public finances allow, aiming to benefit most families and remove more low-paid workers from paying income tax.

source.quote: Our priority for tax cuts, when the public finances allow, will be to cut income tax by raising the tax-free personal allowance, benefitting the vast majority of families and taking more low-paid workers out of paying income tax altogether.

policies.policy_title: Increase Digital Services Tax
policies.stated: Increase the Digital Services Tax on social media firms and other tech giants from 2% to 6%, with revenues contributing to funding mental health professionals in schools.

source.quote: Increasing the Digital Services Tax on social media firms and other tech giants from 2% to 6%.

policies.policy_title: Reform Capital Gains Tax
policies.stated: Fairly reform capital gains tax to close loopholes currently exploited by the super wealthy, aiming to raise money for investment plans.

source.quote: Fairly reforming capital gains tax to close loopholes exploited by the super wealthy.

policies.policy_title: Tax on FTSE-100 Share Buybacks
policies.stated: Introduce a 4% tax on the share buyback schemes of FTSE-100 listed companies, to incentivise productive investment, job creation and economic growth.

source.quote: Introducing a 4% tax on the share buyback schemes of FTSE-100 listed companies, to incentivise productive investment, job creation and economic growth.

policies.policy_title: End Retrospective Tax Changes and Review IR35
policies.stated: End retrospective tax changes such as the loan charge brought in by the Conservatives, and review the Government’s off-payroll working IR35 reforms to ensure self-employed people are treated fairly.

source.quote: End retrospective tax changes such as the loan charge brought in by the Conservatives, and review the Government’s off-payroll working IR35 reforms to ensure self-employed people are treated fairly.

policies.policy_title: Expand British Business Bank
policies.stated: Expand the British Business Bank to perform a more central role in the economy, to ensure that viable small and medium-sized businesses have access to capital, and enable it to help ‘crowd-in’ private investment, in particular in zero-carbon products and technologies.

source.quote: Expand the British Business Bank to perform a more central role in the economy, to ensure that viable small and medium-sized businesses have access to capital, and enable it to help ‘crowd-in’ private investment, in particular in zero-carbon products and technologies.

policies.policy_title: Digital Literacy Target and Clear Terms and Conditions
policies.stated: Set a UK-wide target for digital literacy and require all products to provide short, clear terms and conditions outlining key facts on data and privacy, empowering consumers.

source.quote: Empower consumers and ensure that everyone can enjoy the benefits of new technology, by setting a UK-wide target for digital literacy and requiring all products to provide a short, clear version of their terms and conditions, setting out the key facts as they relate to individuals’ data and privacy.

policies.policy_title: National Financial Inclusion Strategy
policies.stated: Introduce a national financial inclusion strategy, requiring the FCA and PRA to consider financial inclusion, including protecting access to cash, supporting banking hubs, expanding bank account access, delivering Sharia-compliant student finance, and supporting vulnerable consumers.

source.quote: Introduce a national financial inclusion strategy and require both the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority to have regard to financial inclusion, such as protecting access to cash, especially in remote areas, supporting banking hubs, expanding access to bank accounts, delivering Sharia-compliant student finance and supporting vulnerable consumers.

policies.policy_title: Repair UK-EU Trading Relationship
policies.stated: Repair the UK’s broken relationship with Europe by taking unilateral steps, seeking partnerships with EU agencies, negotiating comprehensive veterinary and plant health agreements, mutual recognition agreements, and ultimately aiming to join the Single Market, giving Britain’s farmers the ability to trade with European neighbours with minimal need for checks.

source.quote: Unlock British businesses’ global potential by bringing down trade barriers and building stronger future relationships with our closest trading partners, including by fixing our broken relationship with Europe as set out in chapter 22.

consolidated_from: Negotiate Veterinary and Plant Health Agreements with Europe

policies.policy_title: Skills and Training Levy and Apprenticeship Reform
policies.stated: Replace the broken apprenticeship levy with a broader and more flexible skills and training levy, boost apprenticeship take-up by guaranteeing the National Minimum Wage, create new Lifelong Skills Grants giving all adults £5,000 to spend on education and training throughout their lives (with an ambition to increase to £10,000 when public finances allow), develop National Colleges for key sectors, and expand higher vocational training.

source.quote: Invest in people’s skills by: Replacing the broken apprenticeship levy with a broader and more flexible skills and training levy. Boosting the take-up of apprenticeships, including by guaranteeing they are paid at least the National Minimum Wage by scrapping the lower apprentice rate. Creating new Lifelong Skills Grants for adults to spend on education and training throughout their lives, as set out in chapter 8. Developing National Colleges as national centres of expertise for key sectors, such as renewable energy, to deliver the high-level vocational skills that businesses need. Identifying and seeking to solve skills gaps, such as the lack of advanced technicians, by expanding higher vocational training like foundation degrees, Higher National Diplomas, Higher National Certificates and Higher Apprenticeships. Improving the quality of vocational education, and strengthening careers advice and links with employers in schools and colleges, as set out in chapter 8.

policies.policy_title: Abolish Business Rates and Introduce Commercial Landowner Levy
policies.stated: Abolish business rates and replace them with a Commercial Landowner Levy to boost small businesses and empower them to create new local jobs, helping high streets.

source.quote: Boost small businesses and empower them to create new local jobs, including by abolishing business rates and replacing them with a Commercial Landowner Levy to help our high streets.

policies.policy_title: General Duty of Care for Environment and Human Rights in Supply Chains
policies.stated: Introduce a general duty of care for the environment and human rights in business operations and supply chains, ensuring high standards for environmental, health, labour and consumer protection at least matching EU standards.

source.quote: Introduce a general duty of care for the environment and human rights in business operations and supply chains.

policies.policy_title: Promote Employee Ownership and Company Purpose Reform
policies.stated: Encourage employers to promote employee ownership by giving staff in listed companies with more than 250 employees a right to request shares, to be held in trust for the benefit of employees. Reform fiduciary duty and company purpose rules to ensure that all large companies have a formal statement of corporate purpose, including considerations such as employee welfare, environmental standards, community benefit and ethical practice, alongside benefit to shareholders, and that they report formally on the wider impact of the business on society and the environment.

source.quote: Encourage employers to promote employee ownership by giving staff in listed companies with more than 250 employees a right to request shares, to be held in trust for the benefit of employees. Reform fiduciary duty and company purpose rules to ensure that all large companies have a formal statement of corporate purpose, including considerations such as employee welfare, environmental standards, community benefit and ethical practice, alongside benefit to shareholders, and that they report formally on the wider impact of the business on society and the environment.

policies.policy_title: Extend Public Interest Test for Company Takeovers
policies.stated: Extend the scope of the existing ‘public interest’ test when considering approvals for takeovers of large or strategically significant companies by overseas-based owners to recognise the benefits to the UK economy, workers and consumers of protecting UK companies from speculative or short-term interests.

source.quote: Extend the scope of the existing ‘public interest’ test when considering approvals for takeovers of large or strategically significant companies by overseas-based owners to recognise the benefits to the UK economy, workers and consumers of protecting UK companies from speculative or short-term interests.

policies.policy_title: Tackle Late Payments Crisis
policies.stated: Require all government agencies and contractors and companies with more than 250 employees to sign up to the prompt payment code, making it enforceable.

source.quote: Tackle the late payments crisis by requiring all government agencies and contractors and companies with more than 250 employees to sign up to the prompt payment code, making it enforceable.

policies.policy_title: Worker Protection Enforcement Authority
policies.stated: Establish a powerful new Worker Protection Enforcement Authority unifying responsibilities currently spread across three agencies – including enforcing the minimum wage, tackling modern slavery and protecting agency workers.

source.quote: Establish a powerful new Worker Protection Enforcement Authority unifying responsibilities currently spread across three agencies – including enforcing the minimum wage, tackling modern slavery and protecting agency workers.

policies.policy_title: Independent Review for a Genuine Living Wage
policies.stated: Establish an independent review to recommend a genuine living wage across all sectors, with government departments and all other public sector employers taking a leading role in paying it.

source.quote: Establish an independent review to recommend a genuine living wage across all sectors, with government departments and all other public sector employers taking a leading role in paying it.

policies.policy_title: Modernise Employment Rights for the Gig Economy
policies.stated: Modernise employment rights to make them fit for the age of the ‘gig economy’ by establishing a new ‘dependent contractor’ employment status in between employment and self-employment (with entitlements to basic rights such as minimum earnings levels, sick pay and holiday entitlement), reviewing the tax and National Insurance status of employees, dependent contractors and freelancers to ensure fair and comparable treatment, setting a 20% higher minimum wage for people on zero-hour contracts at times of normal demand, giving a right to request a fixed-hours contract after 12 months for ‘zero hours’ and agency workers (not to be unreasonably refused), reviewing rules concerning pensions for gig economy workers, and shifting the burden of proof in employment tribunals regarding employment status from individual to employer.

source.quote: Modernise employment rights to make them fit for the age of the ‘gig economy’, including by: Establishing a new ‘dependent contractor’ employment status in between employment and self-employment, with entitlements to basic rights such as minimum earnings levels, sick pay and holiday entitlement. Reviewing the tax and National Insurance status of employees, dependent contractors and freelancers to ensure fair and comparable treatment. Setting a 20% higher minimum wage for people on zero-hour contracts at times of normal demand to compensate them for the uncertainty of fluctuating hours of work. Giving a right to request a fixed-hours contract after 12 months for ‘zero hours’ and agency workers, not to be unreasonably refused. Reviewing rules concerning pensions so that those in the gig economy don’t lose out, and portability between roles is protected. Shifting the burden of proof in employment tribunals regarding employment status from individual to employer.

policies.policy_title: Reform Statutory Sick Pay (SSP)
policies.stated: Fix the broken Statutory Sick Pay system by making it available to workers earning less than £123 a week, aligning the rate with the National Minimum Wage, making payments available from the first day of missing work rather than the fourth, and supporting small employers with Statutory Sick Pay costs.

source.quote: Fix the broken Statutory Sick Pay system by: Making it available to the more than one million workers earning less than £123 a week, most of whom are women. Aligning the rate with the National Minimum Wage. Making payments available from the first day of missing work rather than the fourth. Supporting small employers with Statutory Sick Pay costs, consulting with them on the best way to do this.

policies.policy_title: Emergency Home Energy Upgrade Programme
policies.stated: Launch a ten-year emergency Home Energy Upgrade programme to make homes warmer and cheaper to heat, starting with free insulation and heat pumps for those on low incomes, and ensuring all new homes are zero-carbon and fitted with solar panels. Introduce a new subsidised Energy-Saving Homes scheme with pilot programs to identify the most effective combination of tax incentives, loans, grants, and advice/support for energy efficiency.

source.quote: Make homes warmer and cheaper to heat with a ten-year emergency upgrade programme, starting with free insulation and heat pumps for those on low incomes, and ensure that all new homes are zero-carbon. Launching an emergency Home Energy Upgrade programme, with free insulation and heat pumps for low-income households and a central role for local authorities in delivering this programme. Immediately requiring all new homes and non-domestic buildings to be built to a zero-carbon standard, including being fitted with solar panels, and progressively increasing standards as technology improves.

policies.policy_title: Rooftop Solar Revolution and Fair Price for Electricity
policies.stated: Drive a rooftop solar revolution by expanding incentives for households to install solar panels, including a guaranteed fair price for electricity sold back into the grid.

source.quote: Drive a rooftop solar revolution by expanding incentives for households to install solar panels, including a guaranteed fair price for electricity sold back into the grid.

policies.policy_title: 90% Renewable Electricity Target by 2030
policies.stated: Invest in renewable power to ensure that 90% of the UK’s electricity is generated from renewables by 2030, removing restrictions on solar and wind power and supporting tidal/wave power.

source.quote: Invest in renewable power so that 90% of the UK’s electricity is generated from renewables by 2030. Accelerate the deployment of renewable power and deliver energy security by: Removing the Conservatives’ unnecessary restrictions on new solar and wind power, and supporting investment and innovation in tidal and wave power in particular.

policies.policy_title: Chief Secretary for Sustainability and Net Zero Delivery Authority
policies.stated: Appoint a Chief Secretary for Sustainability in the Treasury to ensure that the economy is sustainable, resource-efficient and zero-carbon, establish a new Net Zero Delivery Authority to coordinate action across government departments and work with devolved administrations, and hand more powers and resources to local councils for local net zero strategies.

source.quote: Appoint a Chief Secretary for Sustainability in the Treasury to ensure that the economy is sustainable, resource-efficient and zero-carbon, establish a new Net Zero Delivery Authority to coordinate action across government departments and work with devolved administrations, and hand more powers and resources to local councils for local net zero strategies.

policies.policy_title: National and Local Citizens' Assemblies for Climate Change
policies.stated: Establish national and local citizens’ assemblies to give people real involvement in the decisions needed to tackle climate change.

source.quote: Establish national and local citizens’ assemblies to give people real involvement in the decisions needed to tackle climate change.

policies.policy_title: Restore International Development Spending for Climate Action
policies.stated: Restore the UK’s role as a global leader on climate change, by returning international development spending to 0.7% of national income, with tackling climate change a key priority for development spending.

source.quote: Restore the UK’s role as a global leader on climate change, by returning international development spending to 0.7% of national income, with tackling climate change a key priority for development spending.

policies.policy_title: Landlords to Upgrade Energy Efficiency
policies.stated: Reintroduce requirements for landlords to upgrade the energy efficiency of their properties to EPC C or above by 2028.

source.quote: Reintroducing requirements for landlords to upgrade the energy efficiency of their properties to EPC C or above by 2028.

policies.policy_title: Social Tariff for Vulnerable Households' Energy Bills
policies.stated: Introduce a social tariff for the most vulnerable to provide targeted energy discounts for vulnerable households.

source.quote: Introducing a social tariff for the most vulnerable to provide targeted energy discounts for vulnerable households.

policies.policy_title: Decouple Electricity Prices from Wholesale Gas Price
policies.stated: Decouple electricity prices from the wholesale gas price and eliminate unfair regional differences in domestic energy bills to help people with the cost of living.

source.quote: Decoupling electricity prices from the wholesale gas price. Eliminating unfair regional differences in domestic energy bills.

policies.policy_title: Ban Fracking and New Coal Mines
policies.stated: Maintaining the ban on fracking and introducing a ban on new coal mines.

source.quote: Maintaining the ban on fracking and introducing a ban on new coal mines.

policies.policy_title: End Fossil Fuel Subsidies with Just Transition
policies.stated: Implement the UK’s G7 pledge to end fossil fuel subsidies, while ensuring a just transition that values the skills and experience of people working in the oil and gas industry and provides good opportunities for them, and takes special care of the regions and communities most affected.

source.quote: Implementing the UK’s G7 pledge to end fossil fuel subsidies, while ensuring a just transition that values the skills and experience of people working in the oil and gas industry and provides good opportunities for them, and takes special care of the regions and communities most affected.

policies.policy_title: Regulate Financial Services for Climate-Friendly Investments
policies.stated: Regulating financial services to encourage climate-friendly investments, including requiring pension funds and managers to show that their portfolio investments are consistent with the Paris Agreement, and creating new powers for regulators to act if banks and other investors are not managing climate risks properly.

source.quote: Regulating financial services to encourage climate-friendly investments, including requiring pension funds and managers to show that their portfolio investments are consistent with the Paris Agreement, and creating new powers for regulators to act if banks and other investors are not managing climate risks properly.

policies.policy_title: Implement Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism
policies.stated: Implementing the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism for high-emission products, protecting UK businesses from unfair competition.

source.quote: Implementing the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism for high-emission products, protecting UK businesses from unfair competition.

policies.policy_title: Right to See a GP Within Seven Days (or 24 Hours Urgent)
policies.stated: Give everyone the right to see a GP or the most appropriate practice staff member within seven days, or within 24 hours if they urgently need to, by: Increasing the number of full-time equivalent GPs by 8,000 (half by boosting recruitment and half from retaining more experienced GPs), giving everyone 70+ and everyone with long-term health conditions access to a named GP, freeing up GPs’ time by giving more prescribing rights and public health advisory services to qualified pharmacists, nurse practitioners and paramedics, introducing a universal 24/7 GP booking system, removing top-down bureaucracy, and establishing a Strategic Small Surgeries Fund to sustain services in rural and remote areas.

source.quote: Give everyone the right to see a GP within seven days, or within 24 hours if they urgently need to, with 8,000 more GPs to deliver on it. policies.policy_title: Guarantee NHS Dentist Access for Urgent Care
policies.stated: Guarantee access to an NHS dentist for everyone needing urgent and emergency care, ending DIY dentistry and ‘dental deserts’ by: Bringing dentists back to the NHS from the private sector (fixing the broken NHS dental contract and using flexible commissioning), introducing an emergency scheme to guarantee access to free NHS dental check-ups for eligible groups (children, new mothers, pregnant individuals, low-income individuals), and guaranteeing appointments for all who need a dental check before commencing surgery, chemotherapy or transplant.

source.quote: Guarantee access to an NHS dentist for everyone needing urgent and emergency care, ending DIY dentistry and ‘dental deserts’. policies.policy_title: Improve Early Access to Mental Health Services
policies.stated: Improve early access to mental health services by opening walk-in hubs for children and young people in every community and offering regular mental health check-ups at key points in people’s lives when they are most vulnerable to mental ill-health.

source.quote: Improve early access to mental health services by establishing mental health hubs for young people in every community and introducing regular mental health check-ups at key points in people’s lives when they are most vulnerable to mental ill-health. policies.policy_title: Boost Cancer Survival Rates and 62-Day Treatment Guarantee
policies.stated: Boost cancer survival rates by: Introducing a guarantee that 100% of patients will be able to start treatment within 62 days from urgent referral, replacing ageing radiotherapy machines and increasing their number, recruiting more cancer nurses, passing a Cancer Survival Research Act, and halving the time for new treatments to reach patients by expanding the Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency’s capacity. Also launching a new prostate cancer screening programme for those at higher risk.

policies.policy_title: Invest in Public Health and 'Health Creation Unit'
policies.stated: Help people spend more years of their life in good health by: Increasing the Public Health Grant, with a proportion of the extra funding set aside for those experiencing the worst health inequalities to co-produce plans for their communities. Establishing a ‘Health Creation Unit’ in the Cabinet Office to lead work across government to improve the nation’s health and tackle health inequalities.

policies.policy_title: Ban Single-Use Vapes and Restrict Children's Vaping
policies.stated: Introduce regulations to halt the dangerous use of vapes by children while recognising their role in smoking cessation for adults, and banning the sale of single-use vapes.

source.quote: Introducing regulations to halt the dangerous use of vapes by children while recognising their role in smoking cessation for adults, and banning the sale of single-use vapes.

policies.policy_title: Levy on Tobacco Company Profits
policies.stated: Introduce a new levy on tobacco company profits to help fund healthcare and smoking cessation services.

source.quote: Introducing a new levy on tobacco company profits to help fund healthcare and smoking cessation services.

policies.policy_title: Restrict Junk Food Advertising and Extend Soft Drinks Levy
policies.stated: Protecting children from exposure to junk food by supporting local authorities to restrict outdoor advertising and restricting TV advertising to post-watershed, and extending the soft drinks levy to juice-based and milk-based drinks that are high in added sugar.

source.quote: Protecting children from exposure to junk food by supporting local authorities to restrict outdoor advertising and restricting TV advertising to postwatershed. Extending the soft drinks levy to juice-based and milk-based drinks that are high in added sugar.

policies.policy_title: NHS Staff Retention Plan and Pay Review Body Reform
policies.stated: Train, recruit and retain the doctors, nurses and other NHS staff we need, including by: Establishing a properly independent pay review body, retaining more staff across the NHS through a ten-year retention plan, making flexible working a day-one right and expanding access to flexible, affordable childcare, fixing the work visa system and exempting NHS and care staff from the Immigration Skills Charge, and ending the false economy of spending money on agency workers.

source.quote: Train, recruit and retain the doctors, nurses and other NHS staff we need, including by: Establishing a properly independent pay review body. Fixing the work visa system and exempting NHS and care staff from the Immigration Skills Charge, as set out in chapter 18. Ending the false economy of spending money on agency workers and encouraging the use of flexible staff banks.

policies.policy_title: Fix Ambulance Services Crisis
policies.stated: Fix the life-threatening crisis in our ambulance services by: Ending excessive handover delays for ambulances by increasing the number of staffed hospital beds to end degrading corridor care, and fixing social care. Publishing accessible, localised reports of ambulance response times. Creating an emergency fund to reverse closures of community ambulance stations and cancel planned closures where needed.

policies.policy_title: Ten-Year Plan for NHS Estates Investment
policies.stated: Implement a ten-year plan to invest in hospitals and the primary care estate to end the scandal of crumbling roofs, dangerous concrete and life-expired buildings.

source.quote: Implement a ten-year plan to invest in hospitals and the primary care estate to end the scandal of crumbling roofs, dangerous concrete and life-expired buildings.

policies.policy_title: New Patients' Charter
policies.stated: Create a new ‘Patients Charter’ to harness lived experience of patients and embed patient voice, partnership and safety standards across health and care settings, including: A new legal right to a second opinion. A new legal right to maintain contact in all health and care settings. Protecting patient data and patients’ rights to opt out of data sharing.

policies.policy_title: Implement Infected Blood Inquiry Recommendations
policies.stated: Implement the recommendations of the Infected Blood Inquiry in full, including delivering full and fair compensation to all victims of the scandal in a timely and transparent manner.

source.quote: Implement the recommendations of the Infected Blood Inquiry in full, including delivering full and fair compensation to all victims of the scandal in a timely and transparent manner.

policies.policy_title: Free Personal Care
policies.stated: Introduce free personal care based on the model introduced by the Liberal Democrats in government in Scotland in 2002, so that provision is based on need, not ability to pay, and providing predictable, consistent funding.

source.quote: Introduce free personal care based on the model introduced by the Liberal Democrats in government in Scotland in 2002, so that provision is based on need, not ability to pay. Providing predictable, consistent funding for free personal care.

policies.policy_title: Social Care Workforce Plan and Royal College of Care Workers
policies.stated: Create a social care workforce plan, establish a Royal College of Care Workers to improve recognition and career progression, and introduce a higher Carer’s Minimum Wage (boosting it by £2 an hour) as a starting point for improved pay. This also includes creating clear career pathways, a career ladder to allow flexibility across NHS and social care, and expanding the NHS Digital Staff Passport to include the care sector.

Creating a career ladder to allow flexibility to work across the NHS and social care, allowing staff to gain experience in both. Creating a Royal College of Care Workers to represent this skilled workforce. Expanding the NHS Digital Staff Passport to include the care sector.

policies.policy_title: Cross-Party Commission for Social Care Funding
policies.stated: Establish a cross-party commission to forge a long-term agreement on sustainable funding for social care, addressing the funding crisis facing local authorities.

source.quote: Establish a cross-party commission to forge a long-term agreement on sustainable funding for social care. Tackle the funding crisis facing local authorities, including by providing multi-year settlements, boosting the supply of social housing, and forging a long-term, cross-party agreement on social care.

policies.policy_title: Fair Deal for Unpaid Carers
policies.stated: Give unpaid carers a fair deal by increasing Carer’s Allowance and expanding eligibility for it, introducing a statutory guarantee of regular respite breaks for unpaid carers, introducing paid carer’s leave, and making caring a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010 (requiring employers to make reasonable adjustments).

policies.policy_title: Dedicated Mental Health Professional in Every School
policies.stated: Put a dedicated, qualified mental health professional in every primary and secondary school, making sure all children and parents have someone they can turn to for help, funded by increasing the Digital Services Tax on social media firms and other tech giants.

policies.policy_title: Increase School and College Funding and Repair Buildings

policies.policy_title: Extend Rail Electrification and Improve Stations
policies.stated: Significantly extend the electrification of Britain’s rail network, improve stations, greatly improve disabled access through the Access for All programme, reopen smaller stations and deliver Northern Powerhouse rail.

policies.policy_title: Boost Bus Services and Empower Local Authorities
policies.stated: Boost bus services by giving local authorities more powers to franchise services and simplifying funding, so that bus routes can be restored or new routes added where there is local need, especially in rural areas. policies.policy_title: New Nationwide Active Travel Strategy
policies.stated: Transform how people travel by creating new cycling and walking networks with a new nationwide active travel strategy. Give more of the roads budget to local councils to maintain existing roads, pavements and cycleways, including repairing potholes.

policies.policy_title: Reform Taxation of International Flights and Introduce Private Jet Super Tax
policies.stated: Reduce the climate impact of flying by: Reforming the taxation of international flights to focus on those who fly the most, while reducing costs for ordinary households. policies.policy_title: Protect Public Service Broadcasters
policies.stated: Protect the BBC, S4C, BBC Alba and Channel 4 as independent, publicly owned, public service broadcasters. policies.policy_title: Negotiate Free and Simple Travel for Artists to the EU

policies.policy_title: Boost Sports Participation and Invest in Grassroots Facilities

policies.policy_title: Independent Regulator for Football Clubs

policies.policy_title: End Hostile Environment and Tackle Smuggling/Trafficking

Transferring responsibility for identifying modern slavery victims from the Home Office to local safeguarding agencies.

policies.policy_title: Transfer Work Visas and Overseas Student Policy from Home Office
policies.stated: Transfer policy-making over work visas and overseas students out of the Home Office and into other departments. Replace the Conservatives’ arbitrary salary threshold with a more flexible merit-based system for work visas, with the relevant department working with employers in each sector to address specific needs. Exempt NHS and care staff from the £1,000-a-year Immigration Skills Charge, and reverse the Conservatives’ ban on care workers bringing partners and children.

source.quote: Transfer policy-making over work visas and overseas students out of the Home Office and into other departments. policies.policy_title: Scrap Illegal Migration Act and Rwanda Scheme, Uphold Refugee Convention

policies.policy_title: Tackle Asylum Backlog and Allow Asylum Seekers to Work
policies.stated: Tackle the asylum backlog by establishing a dedicated unit to improve the speed and quality of asylum decision-making, introducing a service standard of three months for all but the most complex asylum claims to be processed, and speeding up returns of those without a right to stay. Lift the ban on asylum seekers working if they have been waiting for a decision for more than three months.

source.quote: Tackle the asylum backlog by establishing a dedicated unit to improve the speed and quality of asylum decision-making, introducing a service standard of three months for all but the most complex asylum claims to be processed, and speeding up returns of those without a right to stay. policies.policy_title: Expand Youth Mobility Scheme
policies.stated: Expand the Youth Mobility Scheme by: Negotiating with the EU to extend it on a reciprocal basis. Increasing the age limit from 30 to 35. Abolishing the fees for these visas. Extending the length of visas from two to three years.

policies.policy_title: Reverse Unfair Increase to Family Visa Income Thresholds

policies.policy_title: Repeal Discriminatory 'Right to Rent' Scheme
policies.stated: Repeal the Conservatives’ discriminatory ‘Right to Rent’ scheme that turns landlords into border guards. Establish a firewall to prevent public agencies from sharing personal information with the Home Office for the purposes of immigration enforcement and repeal the immigration exemption in the Data Protection Act.

source.quote: Repeal the Conservatives’ discriminatory ‘Right to Rent’ scheme that turns landlords into border guards. policies.policy_title: End Immigration Detention of Children and Limit Adult Detention

policies.policy_title: Champion Human Rights Act
policies.stated: Champion the Human Rights Act and resist any attempts to weaken or repeal it. Upholding the UK’s commitment to the European Convention on Human Rights and resisting any attempts to withdraw from it.

policies.policy_title: Comprehensive Race Equality Strategy
policies.stated: Develop and implement a comprehensive Race Equality Strategy to address deep inequalities, including in education, health, criminal justice and the economy. This includes reducing the disproportionately high maternal mortality rates for black women, ending the disproportionate use of Stop and Search, requiring police forces to adopt ambitious diversity targets, implementing the Windrush Lessons Learned Review, scrapping the Conservatives’ voter ID scheme, requiring political parties to publish candidate diversity data, and halting the use of facial recognition surveillance.

source.quote: Develop and implement a comprehensive Race Equality Strategy to address deep inequalities, including in education, health, criminal justice and the economy. policies.policy_title: Make Misogyny a Hate Crime

policies.policy_title: New Right to Flexible Working and Work from Home for Disabled People
policies.stated: Give everyone a new right to flexible working and every disabled person the right to work from home if they want to, unless there are significant business reasons why it is not possible.

policies.policy_title: Protect LGBT+ Rights and Ban Conversion Therapies

policies.policy_title: Scrap Draconian Anti-Protest Laws and Halt Facial Recognition Surveillance
policies.stated: Scrap the Conservatives’ draconian anti-protest laws, restoring preexisting protections for both peaceful assembly and public safety, and immediately halt the use of live facial recognition surveillance by the police and private companies.

policies.policy_title: New Right to Affordable Legal Assistance and Reform Legal Aid
policies.stated: Establishing a new right to affordable, reasonable legal assistance, and making the Legal Aid system simpler, fairer and more generous.

policies.stated: Introducing a Digital Bill of Rights to protect everyone’s rights online, including the rights to privacy, free expression, and participation without being subjected to harassment and abuse. policies.stated: Tackle the specific economic barriers facing women by: Ending the gender price gap so that women are not charged more than men for practically identical products or services marketed at them. Ending period poverty by introducing a right for anyone who needs them to access free period products.

policies.stated: Reform the gender recognition process to remove the requirement for medical reports, recognise non-binary identities in law, and remove the spousal veto.

policies.policy_title: Improve Diversity in Workplace and Public Life
policies.stated: Improve diversity in the workplace and public life by: Requiring large employers to monitor and publish data on gender, ethnicity, disability, and LGBT+ employment levels, pay gaps and progression, and publish five-year aspirational diversity targets. Extending the use of name-blind recruitment processes in the public sector and encouraging their use in the private sector. policies.policy_title: Introduce Proportional Representation for MPs and Local Councillors
policies.stated: Ensure no politician can take you for granted, by introducing proportional representation by the Single Transferable Vote for electing MPs, and local councillors in England.

policies.policy_title: Strengthen Democratic Rights and Participation
policies.stated: Strengthen democratic rights and participation by scrapping the Conservatives’ voter ID scheme and giving 16- and 17-year-olds the right to vote in UK general elections and referendums, and local elections in England.

policies.policy_title: Transfer Powers from Westminster and Whitehall, Written Federal Constitution
policies.stated: Transfer greater powers away from Westminster and Whitehall, introduce a written constitution for a federal United Kingdom with strong voices for England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland, and oppose a second Scottish independence referendum and independence.

policies.stated: Reversing the Conservative Government’s cut to the Army, with a longerterm ambition of increasing regular troop numbers back to over 100,000. policies.policy_title: Maintain Nuclear Deterrent While Pursuing Global Disarmament
policies.stated: Maintaining the UK’s nuclear deterrent with four submarines providing continuous at-sea deterrence, while pursuing multilateral global disarmament.

source.quote: Maintaining the UK’s nuclear deterrent with four submarines providing continuous at-sea deterrence, while pursuing multilateral global disarmament.

policies.policy_title: Control Arms Exports to Countries with Poor Human Rights Records

policies.stated: Legislate to ensure there is a parliamentary vote before engaging in military action, and support intervention only when there is a clear legal or humanitarian case, while preserving the government’s ability to engage in action in emergencies with a retrospective vote or under treaty obligation.

policies.policy_title: Work to Counter Global Rise in Authoritarianism
policies.stated: Work to counter the global rise in authoritarianism by championing the liberal, rules-based international order and supporting international institutions such as the United Nations, the Commonwealth, NATO and the International Criminal Court.

policies.stated: Advocate for an immediate bilateral ceasefire in the Israel-Gaza conflict to resolve the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza, get the hostages out, and provide the space to reach a two-state solution based on 1967 borders with security and dignity for Israelis and Palestinians.
